strings.(어디선가 불어온 강한 소용돌이가 오르카리움 캠프 앞을 뒤흔든다.): (A fierce whirlwind sweeps in from nowhere and shakes the area before Orcarium Camp.)
What is this wind? I have a bad feeling... I always seem to be right at times like this.
strings.(하늘에서 뭔가 발견한 페타가 마법서를 찢어 주문을 외우자 주위에 마법진: (Spotting something in the sky, Feta tears pages from his spellbook and chants. Magic circles appear around him.)
strings.(하지만, 마법진들은 날아오는 마도골렘의 공격에 한 순간에 소멸하고 만다: (But an incoming magic golem’s attack obliterates the circles in an instant.)
strings.이 정도니까 다른 마법사들이 다들 안오겠다고 한 거겠지. 그러면 어쩔 수: So this is why all the other mages refused to come. Nothing for it, then.
strings.(페타가 달아나려고 등을 돌리자 발걸음이 그만 멈추고 만다.): (Feta turns to flee, only to stop in his tracks.)
strings.안녕…은 무슨 안녕이야. 리카리아, 이 마법사를 붙잡아!: Hello...? What do you mean, hello? Licaria, grab this mage!
strings.(리카리아가 노네임의 지시를 받자마자 그대로 페타를 붙잡아 하늘로 올린다: (At No Name’s command, Licaria seizes Feta and lifts him into the air.)
Answer my questions, and I will let you live.
strings.그걸 믿으라고?: You expect me to believe that?
Believe it or do not. Your choice.
strings.아, 알았어. 뭐, 뭐가 알고 싶은 거야?: A-all right. What do you want to know?
strings.나 어떻게 살아난거야?: How did I come back to life?
strings.그걸 내가 어떻게 알아? 네 마력이 계속해서 공명하고 있었는데, 죽었다고: How should I know? Your magic has been resonating this whole time. You died? What are you talking about? Dead people do not give off magic...
Then I really am alive now...
strings.마녀에 대해 알고 있는 걸 다 말해. 마녀가 너에게 어떤 표식을 해뒀다는: Tell me everything you know about the witches. I know a witch left some sort of mark on you.
At the Magic Bureau, a woman who called herself a witch asked me to become her servant.
When I refused, she told me to give that adventurer a piece of paper. That is all.
strings.혹시 그 여자 이름, 얼굴하고 이름 기억나?: That woman’s name... Do you remember her face and name?
All I remember is that a mage called Zephyros was there. Everything else is gone.
You lost your memories after all.
strings.내가 아는 게 있으면 여기까지 이런 일 하러 왔겠냐고!!: If I knew anything, would I have come all the way out here to do this job?!
But is there nothing else? About the Magic Bureau’s experiments, for instance...
I will not kill you. The witch did not kill you either, after all.
There are many experiments, but one took priority over the rest. Something to do with souls...
Moving them between different bodies, merging them...
Both your soul and your body...
strings.(이야기를 전부 들은 노네임이 만족한 것 같은 표정을 짓는다.): (After hearing the whole story, No Name looks satisfied.)
strings.이제 놓아줘…. 이렇게 높은 곳에 있기 싫다고…. 너, 뭐야? 그, 그,: Let me go now... I do not want to be this high up... What is that look? W-why are you making that face...?
strings.(페타가 노네임의 미묘한 표정 변화를 발견하고 놀란다.): (Feta notices the subtle change in No Name’s expression and recoils.)
strings.(리카리아가 이름이 불리자 노네임을 향해 몸을 돌린다. 그러자 노네임이: (At the sound of its name, Licaria turns toward No Name. No Name smiles brightly.)
strings.지금부터 플랜 B, 그러니까 마녀들 잡으러 가는 거야. 재미있겠지?: Time for Plan B. In other words, we are going witch hunting. Sounds fun, does it not?
